sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t1.installment_ref), CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN t2.type = 'Cast' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(DISTINCT t1.installment_ref) FROM installment AS t1 INNER JOIN recognition AS t2 ON t1.installment_ref = t2.installment_ref WHERE t1.cycle = 9 AND t1.franchise = 'Law and Order'

SELECT t1.label FROM tag AS t1 INNER JOIN installment AS t2 ON t1.installment_ref = t2.installment_ref WHERE t2.ballot_count NOT IN (SELECT MAX(ballot_count) FROM installment) ORDER BY t2.ballot_count DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT DISTINCT t1.natal_zone FROM individual AS t1 INNER JOIN recognition AS t2 ON t1.individual_ref = t2.individual_ref WHERE t2.capacity = 'assistant location manager'

SELECT COUNT(t1.accolade_ref) FROM accolade AS t1 INNER JOIN installment AS t2 ON t1.installment_ref = t2.installment_ref WHERE t1.annum = 1999 AND t1.body = 'Primetime Emmy Awards' AND t1.outcome = 'Nominee' AND t2.installment_ordinal = 20 AND t2.franchise = 'Law and Order'

SELECT t2.installment_ref, t2.capacity FROM individual AS t1 INNER JOIN accolade AS t2 ON t1.individual_ref = t2.individual_ref WHERE t2.annum = 1999 AND t2.prize = 'Outstanding Guest Actress in a Drama Series' AND t2.body = 'Primetime Emmy Awards' AND t1.moniker = 'Julia Roberts' AND t2.outcome = 'Nominee'

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN t1.natal_nation = 'USA' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(*), t2.capacity FROM individual AS t1 INNER JOIN recognition AS t2 ON t1.individual_ref = t2.individual_ref INNER JOIN installment AS t3 ON t2.installment_ref = t3.installment_ref WHERE t2.type = 'Cast' AND t3.installment_ordinal = 2
